text:
Tandem Health | Engineers, PMs, Designers | On-site in Stockholm, Sweden | Full time

At Tandem Health we're building a clinician copilot to allow clinicians to focus on care rather than administration. We’re building, launching and iterating quickly, and are rolling out across some of the largest care chains across Europe, including most of the NHS.

Our first product listens in to the patient-clinician encounter to generate medical records, allowing clinicians to save 5-10 minutes per patient. We're rapidly expanding our product suite now, with medical coding and clinical decision support out today, and more products on the way.

We’re expanding our Stockholm team with exceptionally driven builders in a wide range of roles. Especially on the lookout for Product Manager, Head of Product Design, and Director of Engineering.

More info and application at https://tandemhealth.ai/about/careers

Feel free to reach out to me at john.moberg[at]tandemhealth.ai if you have any questions, but please don't send applications my way
